jobs.name: needs-input-sla-probe-emit
jobs.prompt:
Run the needs_input SLA probe emit sweep. Execute exactly: python3 /home/frank/.hermes/agent-hooks/needs-input-sla-probe.py --emit --heartbeat /tmp/needs-input-sla-probe.heartbeat

Report what happened: exit code, stdout/stderr, whether a card was created, any errors. This runs every 6 hours across all boards (jarvis-os, sycode-trading, upero). If exit != 0, report the error clearly.

jobs.name: needs-input-sla-probe-liveness
jobs.prompt:
Run the needs_input SLA probe liveness monitor. Execute exactly: python3 /home/frank/.hermes/agent-hooks/needs-input-sla-probe-liveness.py --heartbeat /tmp/needs-input-sla-probe.heartbeat

If exit code is 0: report OK and the last sweep age. If exit code is 1: report ALARM with the missing-or-stale heartbeat details and severity. This runs every 7 hours to detect when the 6-hour emit probe fails silently. If exit != 0, escalate clearly.
